improvements.message: Consider adding more sophisticated scoring logic to account for nuanced audience engagement metrics, such as sentiment analysis or time-weighted engagement trends.
Enhance filtering capabilities to support multi-select filters for categories and games, as this could improve usability for users managing diverse datasets.
Consider implementing IndexedDB for local data persistence to handle larger datasets and improve scalability.
Include wireframes or mockups for better visualization of the user interface design.
Add a section on potential future enhancements, such as integration with external APIs or advanced analytics features, to provide a roadmap for the project's evolution.

payload.quality_target: The project meets the current user requirements and is well-structured for its intended scope. Future improvements could focus on enhancing scalability, advanced analytics, and user interface features.
